summary: Both genes in Appendix Figure S7D increased in knockout hypothalamus. The plotted log2 fold changes were approximately +1.79 for Agrp and +1.13 for Npy, compared with +1.746 and +1.128 in the registered output. Both registered raw P values were below 0.05. Author FDR remains unassessed. [Appendix Figure S7D, pages 16–17](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC10331581.1/EMMM-15-e16951-s003.pdf)
openIssues: Figure S7D reports six per genotype. GEO and ENA identify four hypothalamic libraries per genotype. Which mice and libraries contributed to the figure?

The public sources reviewed provided no full gene-level author table. The two selected pairs fall below the comparison runner’s three-pair minimum and the concordance policy’s 30-pair minimum. The proposal therefore omits a comparison spec and leaves full verification open.
